title: 跨平台同步把不同资产文件名折叠成同一键

history.evidence: Squashed commit introduces reversible filename codec and retains legacy_sanitize_segment for dual-key lookup. Backport restores the documented historical lossy sanitizer as the encoder. Original individual subcommit is not retained; this is a behavior backport, not byte-identical revert.

problem_zh: 同步某些文件名包含特殊字符、尾部标点、保留名称或不同 Unicode 组合形式的资产后，会出现名称碰撞或无法还原原名。请保证跨平台云端键能区分合法的不同用户原名并能无损还原，兼容旧键查找，拒绝路径穿越和过长名称。
test_scope: Direct compilation of complete production Rust modules through #[path]; unrelated learner-profile dependency panics if invoked. No production function is copied.
